# The market-data pack

*Market data* · version 1.0.0 · code `MKT`

## What it is

The market data the trading and risk packs price with: interest-rate, repo, FX-forward, credit, dividend, inflation and commodity
curves; FX, cap, swaption, equity and commodity volatility surfaces; FX spots, equities, equity indexes, commodities, bonds, rate
fixings, inflation indexes and a correlation matrix. Products select their curves and surfaces by the ids defined here.

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `ir-curve`

**Interest rate curve** · mnemonic `CRV` · read through connector `market-store`.

**Id:** field `CURVE_ID`; pattern `^CRV-`; for example `CRV-AUD-BASIS`.

Fields, from 28 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CURVE_ID` | string | `CRV-AUD-BASIS` | The document's id |
| `CURRENCY` | string | `AUD` | Currency |
| `CURVE_TYPE` | string | `Cross-currency basis` | Type |
| `INDEX` | string | `AONIA` | Index |
| `TEN_Y` | number | `0.042199999999999994` | 10Y |
| `SLOPE_2S_10S` | number | `51.2` | 2s10s |
| `AS_OF` | date | `2026-09-30` | As of |
| `POINTS` | list of objects |  | The curve's pillars (tenor, date, rate, discount factor) |
| `FORWARDS` | list of objects |  | Forward rates read off the curve |
| `INTERPOLATION` | string | `Log-linear on discount factors` | Interpolation method, e.g. log-linear on discount factors |
| `DAY_COUNT` | string | `ACT/365F` | Day-count convention |
| `CALENDAR` | string | `CAL-GBLO` | Holiday calendar id; link to `calendar` |
| `FIXING_INDEX` | string | `FIX-AONIA` | link to `rate-fixing` |
| `BUILT_AT` | timestamp | `2026-09-30T18:02:41Z` | When the curve was built |
| `SOURCES` | list of strings |  | Quote sources the curve was built from |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `POINTS[]` | `TENOR` (string), `MATURITY` (date), `INSTRUMENT` (string), `QUOTE` (number), `ZERO_RATE` (number), `DF` (number) |
| `FORWARDS[]` | `TENOR` (string), `RATE` (number) |

Links: `CALENDAR` → `calendar`, `FIXING_INDEX` → `rate-fixing`.

### `fx-spot`

**FX spot rate** · mnemonic `FX` · read through connector `market-store`.

| `ISIN` | string | `BND-BRVERD054608` | The document's id |
| `ISIN_CODE` | string | `BRVERD054608` | The ISIN without the BND- prefix |
| `ISSUER_NAME` | string | `Verdant Agri Holdings` | Issuer |
| `COUPON` | number | `0.0579` | Coupon |
| `MATURITY` | date | `2031-09-15` | Maturity |
| `PRICE` | number | `94.302` | Price |
| `YIELD` | number | `0.071` | Yield |
| `Z_SPREAD` | number | `323.0` | Z-spread |
| `MOD_DURATION` | number | `4.35` | Duration |
| `RATING` | string | `BB-` | Rating |
| `TERMS` | object |  | Issue terms |
| `COUPONS` | list of objects |  | Coupon schedule |
| `HISTORY` | list of objects |  | Daily price and yield |
| `ISSUER` | string | `ISS-VERDANT` | link to `issuer` |
| `BENCHMARK_CURVE` | string | `CRV-USD-GOVT` | link to `ir-curve` |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `TERMS` | `CURRENCY` (string), `COUPON_FREQUENCY` (string), `DAY_COUNT` (string), `ISSUE_DATE` (date), `AMOUNT_ISSUED` (integer), `SENIORITY` (string), `CALLABLE` (boolean), `CUSIP` (string) |
| `COUPONS[]` | `DATE` (date), `AMOUNT` (number) |
| `HISTORY[]` | `DATE` (date), `PRICE` (number) |

Links: `BENCHMARK_CURVE` → `ir-curve`, `ISSUER` → `issuer`.

### `correlation-matrix`

**Correlation matrix** · mnemonic `CORR` · read through connector `market-store`.

**Id:** field `MATRIX_ID`; pattern `^CORR-`; for example `CORR-EU-EQ`.

Fields, from 3 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MATRIX_ID` | string | `CORR-EU-EQ` | The document's id |
| `NAME` | string | `European equities` | Name |
| `FACTORS` | list of strings |  | The risk factors of the set |
| `EQUITY_IDS` | list of strings |  | The factors that are equities (their price history); link to `equity` |
| `FX_IDS` | list or list of strings |  | The factors that are FX pairs (their price history); link to `fx-spot` |

Links: `EQUITY_IDS` → `equity`, `FX_IDS` → `fx-spot`.

### `correlation-result`

**Correlations of a factor set (computed from price history)** · mnemonic `CORRC` · read through connector `correlation-engine`.

**Id:** set by its connector (no samples ship).

No samples ship: documents are read live from its connector `correlation-engine` (plugin `reactive`).

### `equity-beta`

**An equity's beta against its index (computed from price history)** · mnemonic `EQB` · read through connector `equity-analytics`.

**Id:** set by its connector (no samples ship).

No samples ship: documents are read live from its connector `equity-analytics` (plugin `reactive`). The fields its screens show:

| Field | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `ALPHA` | Alpha (a daily log return) |
| `AVAILABLE` | Returns |
| `BETA` | Beta |
| `CORRELATION` | Correlation |
| `EQUITY` | Equity |
| `FROM` | From |
| `INDEX` | Index |
| `INDEX_VOLATILITY` | Index volatility (annualised) |
| `R_SQUARED` | R squared |
| `TO` | To |
| `VOLATILITY` | Volatility (annualised) |
| `WINDOW` | Window (0: every return) |

Links: `CORRELATION` → `correlation-matrix`, `EQUITY` → `equity`.

## Data sources and licences

The committed samples are synthetic. Five feed connectors (off by default) read the same kinds live from official public sources;
`tools/publicdata/official_market_data.py` captures those sources to files in the data folder, never over the samples.

| Source | Licence | Internal only | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Synthetic sample data (tools/packgen/banking) | Proprietary (part of Drishti); fictitious names and figures | no | every document in samples/ and the demo lake |
| Official public data (ECB, US Treasury, New York Fed, FRED) through the feed connectors | Public sources, attribution; read live, off by default | no | rate-fixing, fx-spot and ir-curve when the feed connectors are on |

Every kind's data contract (each column: type, key, example, links) and where its data comes from (an external source and its refresh script, a generator of synthetic data, or a Drishti engine) are in the guide, [guides/market-data.md](guides/market-data.md): *Data contracts* and *Data retrieval*.

External data: Official public data (ECB, US Treasury, New York Fed, FRED) through the feed connectors. Each source's URL, licence, refresh script and worked examples (Linux and Windows) are on the External data help page, [docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md](../../../docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md).

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on the packs `core`.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `market-store` | `delta` | `ir-curve`, `repo-curve`, `fx-spot`, `fx-forward-curve`, `fx-vol-surface`, `ir-vol-cube`, `cap-vol-surface`, `equity`, `equity-index`, `dividend-curve`, `equity-vol-surface`, `credit-curve`, `inflation-index`, `inflation-curve`, `commodity`, `commodity-curve`, `commodity-vol-surface`, `rate-fixing`, `bond`, `correlation-matrix` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `nyfed-sofr-feed` | `feed` | `rate-fixing` | `${DRISHTI_FEED_NYFED_SOFR:false}` |
| `ecb-estr-feed` | `feed` | `rate-fixing` | `${DRISHTI_FEED_ECB_ESTR:false}` |
| `ecb-fx-feed` | `feed` | `fx-spot` | `${DRISHTI_FEED_ECB_FX:false}` |
| `us-treasury-feed` | `feed` | `ir-curve` | `${DRISHTI_FEED_US_TREASURY:false}` |
| `fred-feed` | `feed` | `rate-fixing` | `${DRISHTI_FEED_FRED:false}` |
| `correlation-engine` | `reactive` | `correlation-result` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `equity-analytics` | `reactive` | `equity-beta` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_DELTA_ROOT`, `DRISHTI_FEED_ECB_ESTR`, `DRISHTI_FEED_ECB_FX`, `DRISHTI_FEED_FRED`, `DRISHTI_FEED_NYFED_SOFR`, `DRISHTI_FEED_US_TREASURY`, `DRISHTI_FRED_SERIES`, `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`, `FRED_API_KEY`.

## Refreshing the data

`python3 tools/publicdata/official_market_data.py status` lists the external sources, their licences and when each was last refreshed (offline); `refresh --dry-run` shows what a refresh would fetch and write, changing nothing; `refresh` fetches, writes and checks. The External data help page (docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md) has worked examples for Linux and Windows.

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/banking/make_docs.py`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.
